instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Tell me what was said in a listening since I last asked, once what was said before my question is written down", and give it listening (The listening's name); conversation (The conversation asking, so it is given each turn once).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:ask-what-was-said and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Waits (at most wait_seconds) until what was said before the ask is heard and written, from the listening's status row; then answers the turns this conversation was not given yet, with the captions' corrections applied, and moves the conversation's cursor past them.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: heard (records:list); listening-status (records:read); captions (records:read); ask-cursor (records:read, records:write).
